duplicateDependencies.name: brotli
duplicateDependencies.constraint: woff2-patched 0.4.0 requires brotli 7 while the owned encoder uses brotli 8
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove brotli 7 with the woff2-patched override after an upstream-compatible decoder passes the permanent regression corpus.

duplicateDependencies.name: brotli-decompressor
duplicateDependencies.constraint: The brotli 7 compatibility chain resolves decompressor 4 while current compression code and allsorts resolve decompressor 5.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove version 4 when the woff2-patched brotli 7 dependency is removed.

duplicateDependencies.name: hashbrown
duplicateDependencies.constraint: The wasmi 0.46 variation runtime resolves hashbrown 0.15 through string-interner, while the workspace indexmap dependency resolves hashbrown 0.17.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove version 0.15 after wasmi/string-interner aligns with the indexmap dependency and the variable-font reduction regression suite passes.

duplicateDependencies.name: thiserror
duplicateDependencies.constraint: woff2-patched and safer-bytes require thiserror 1 while workspace diagnostics use thiserror 2.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove version 1 with the woff2-patched and safer-bytes overrides.

duplicateDependencies.name: thiserror-impl
duplicateDependencies.constraint: Procedural macro versions follow the two reviewed thiserror runtime versions.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove version 1 with the corresponding thiserror 1 dependency chain.

duplicateDependencies.name: unicode-width
duplicateDependencies.constraint: miette 7 currently resolves unicode-width directly and through textwrap at different compatible major versions.
duplicateDependencies.replacementCondition: Remove the older version when a miette/textwrap release unifies the dependency without changing diagnostics.
